intro: Jobs similar to aerospace engineers are mostly other engineering disciplines. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Materials Engineers, Automotive Engineers and Chemical Engineers, each 84% similar. 17 of the 20 careers are in the same engineering group.
shared: These careers share design and testing under strict safety limits, plus heavy use of math, physics and simulation. O*NET rates complex problem solving and judgment at 4 out of 5 for aerospace engineers, and operations analysis at 3.88. Mechanical, wind energy and materials engineering use the same core. Because aerospace pays well, none of the 20 has a higher median than the $134,960 aerospace figure.

faq.q: Do any jobs like aerospace engineer pay more?
faq.a: No. None of the 20 similar careers has a higher BLS May 2025 median than aerospace engineers. Chemical Engineers come closest at $125,040, which is 7% less, followed by Materials Engineers at $112,860, which is 16% less than the aerospace median.

faq.q: What jobs like aerospace engineering need less schooling?
faq.a: 2 of the 20 similar careers usually need less preparation: Mechanical Drafters and industrial engineering technologists and technicians. Mechanical Drafters are 82% similar and earn $71,550, which is 47% less than aerospace engineers, and often hire with an associate degree.
